text.content:
By the most commonly accepted account, the viziers are the eldest of the three castes, tracing themselves to Haqim's first brood of artisans and sages. The viziers originated as seekers of knowledge and became the clan's thinkers, creators, and occasional leaders after the fall of the Second City, maintaining the closest contact with mortal society of any caste. Their culture is a loose affiliation of individualists who keep to themselves outside of mentor-protégé arrangements or cooperative ventures.

Nickname: Scholars or Artisans

Caste Disciplines: Auspex, Celerity, Quietus

Sect: Over a third of the caste may be considered dispossessed; the majority of the remainder followed al-Ashrad to the Camarilla, with a significant minority remaining loyal to Alamut.

Background: Viziers usually Embrace individuals exceptionally dedicated to their chosen profession, with no particular preference for gender or ethnicity.

Character Creation: Viziers favor Social or Mental Attributes depending on individual professions and are the Children of Haqim most likely to have Influence and Resources in mortal society. Nearly all viziers follow Humanity; few adopt the Path of Blood, but those who do pursue it with unusual brutality.

The viziers have no formal caste-wide structure, resembling a loose organization of vaguely affiliated professionals rather than a military order or occult conspiracy. Prestige depends on who an individual vizier knows and what she's accomplished, and varies by audience. The caste maintains one distinct custom drawn from Arab scholarly tradition: academic lineage is considered as important as blood descent, so a vizier's instructors may matter more than his sire when making formal introductions.

Bloodlines: One group active in Byzantine politics still favors Presence over Celerity; perhaps two dozen survivors and descendants of this courtier line exist in the modern nights, largely confined to the Middle East and acting on their own agendas in the courts of the Ashirra.

Note on caste weaknesses: See the Assamite Caste Weaknesses (Variant Rules) entry in the rules reference for the optional Storyteller systems governing vizier-specific weaknesses (the Obsessive/Compulsive derangement tied to the vizier's strongest intellectual or creative Ability).
